sections.text_helper: Section 72.3.4 "Battery charging" in chapter 72 (USB subsystem (USBSS)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3754.
sections.section_content:
The OTGPHY2 integrates the voltage and current sources, as well as the voltage
comparators required to support Battery Charging v1.2. The relevant control bits are
implemented in OTG_GCCFG register of OTG2.
The control sequence is the same as for the USB2 OTG high-speed Port 1.
